description: A source of key-value settings (JSON file, environment variables, user secrets, command line) stacked so that later providers override earlier ones key by key.
A flattened path such as `Shipping:FlatRate:Price`, written as `Shipping__FlatRate__Price` in environment variables.
A per-user JSON file outside the repository, managed with `dotnet user-secrets`, that is loaded only in the Development environment.
Binding a configuration section to a typed class and injecting it as `IOptions<T>`, `IOptionsSnapshot<T>` or `IOptionsMonitor<T>`.
An `OptionsBuilder` call that runs options validation when the host starts, so invalid settings fail the deploy instead of the first request.
A singleton options accessor whose `CurrentValue` reflects reloaded configuration and which raises change notifications.
